title: TUIT Alumni – Alumni Fund Established!
quote: Students are the future of our country, and supporting them is an honor.
description: Dear TUIT graduates! An official and transparent mechanism — the TUIT Alumni Fund — has been established to support talented, hardworking, financially needy, and differently-abled students studying at our university.
features: You can contribute to scholarships and grants for talented students
You can support students facing difficult social conditions
You can help improve student dormitory conditions
You can assist in modernizing educational laboratories, libraries, and infrastructure
You can support startups, scientific research, and innovative initiatives
transparency: The fund operates based on the principles of transparency, openness, and accountability. Regular reports are provided for every allocated fund.
